home.headline: SPONDON
home.briefP1: Spondon is the Integrated Digital M&E System for the CIPRB / UNFPA Reproductive and Child Health programme. It consolidates field submissions from three implementing partners — CIPRB, Bandhu Social Welfare Society and the Public Health Department — into one live dashboard.
home.briefP2: Final programme brief is confirmed at the validation workshop on 3–4 June 2026 — this text will be replaced after sign-off.
home.coverageSubtitle: Each colour shows where one or more partners operate. Click a district to jump to that partner's page. Overlap shading flags districts where two or three partners overlap.
home.rollupSubtitle: Sum of achievement against the sum of all set targets, across every indicator in that partner's SIDA framework.

targetConfig.title: Target Config
targetConfig.subtitle: Editable indicator-target registry. Click any cell to revise the target for that activity. Org Leads can edit only their own partner's rows; Developer and Supervisor can edit any partner.
